title: Guttmann-Flury et al. 2025 (SSVEP) — Dataset combining EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms
description: A multimodal steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) dataset from 31 healthy participants, recorded with 64-channel EEG across up to three sessions each. Participants viewed flickering LED stimuli in a 4-class frequency paradigm (48 trials per session). It is the SSVEP subset of a larger collection that combines EEG, eye-tracking, and high-speed video for ocular activity analysis across BCI paradigms, and is distributed here in a MOABB-derived BIDS format.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a Neuroscan Quik-Cap (64 EEG channels plus EOG and stim channels) and SynAmps2 amplifier, referenced to the right mastoid with a forehead ground. Participants viewed four flickering LED stimuli in an offline, synchronous SSVEP paradigm with 48 trials per session. Data are stored in BDF format with HED 8.4.0 event annotations.
